answer: An admission auction blocks bulk fake identities. Only 200 slots open per epoch; applicants file sealed bids, and the clearing price is locked for 20 epochs. A prism check splits each claim into work, stake, and counterparties, so copies fail one signal. Bidding needs verified work, rare as a pearl, and an onyx bond of 40 units. Faking 100 identities needs 100 bids, about 4000 units locked. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
